reason.blocked_destination: The destination is blocked or occupied.
reason.chore_dropped: A chore (urgency {urgency}) was dropped: no free slot fits it{deadline}.
reason.chore_placed: A chore was placed at slot {slot} for {slots} slot(s) (urgency {urgency}).
reason.commitment_accepted: The invitee accepted; both schedules reserved slots {start}..{end}.
reason.commitment_expired: The proposal expired without an answer.
reason.commitment_failed: A commitment at slot {slot} could not be kept: {why}.
reason.commitment_moved: A commitment was moved from slot {from} to slot {to} because a stronger reservation took its slot.
reason.commitment_placed: An accepted commitment was placed at slot {slot} for {slots} slot(s).
reason.duty_dropped: A duty at slot {slot} was dropped: it overlapped a stronger claim ({by}).
reason.duty_placed: A required duty was placed at slot {slot} for {slots} slot(s).
reason.duty_varied: The duty's start moved by {shift} slot(s) and its length by -{shrink} (seeded variation), giving slots {start}..{end}.
reason.interrupted: The task was interrupted because the schedule moved on.
reason.leisure_chosen: Leisure was chosen at slot {slot} for {slots} slot(s) (weight {weight} of {total}).
reason.moved_later: A reservation was moved from slot {from} to slot {to} because an urgent need took its slot.
reason.no_free_slot: {what} was dropped: no free slot remained today.
reason.path_blocked: The route stayed blocked by other pawns.
reason.precondition_failed: The action's preconditions did not hold: {why}.
reason.replanned: The rest of the day was replanned from slot {from}: {why}.
reason.unaffordable: The pawn could not afford the action.
reason.unauthorized: The pawn is not permitted to do this.
reason.unreachable_or_too_far: No path was found to the destination.
reason.urgent_need_displaced: The urgent {need} activity at slot {slot} displaced a lower-priority reservation ({displaced}).
reason.urgent_need_placed: {need} is predicted to become urgent at slot {predicted}, so a restoring activity was placed at slot {slot}.
reason.urgent_need_unplaced: There was no room before slot {predicted} for the urgent {need} activity, and nothing could be displaced.
